description: This file defines the BrowseFragment class for the Android TV recipe app, responsible for displaying a grid of recipes and a side navigation with filtering options. It manages UI setup, ViewModel interaction, and navigation.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: Fragment for browsing recipes with grid display and filtering options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel with a mock repository.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up views, recipe grid, filters, and observes ViewModel state.

methods.name: setupRecipeGrid
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView for recipes with a grid layout.

methods.name: setupFilters
methods.description: Sets up filter RecyclerView and observes available cuisines and selected filter.

methods.name: observeViewModel
methods.description: Observes UI state changes from ViewModel to update UI accordingly.

methods.name: showEmpty
methods.description: Displays empty view when no recipes are available.

methods.name: navigateToDetail
methods.description: Navigates to the recipe detail screen.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the BrowseFragment.
